name: testpilot
description: TestPilot — turn manual QA workflows into reliable automated tests

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @testpilot/evidence --filter @testpilot/runner-web build && concurrently -n demo,api,ui,open -c blue,magenta,green,yellow "pnpm --filter @testpilot/demo-webapp start" "pnpm --filter @testpilot/test-management dev" "pnpm --filter @testpilot/console dev" "node scripts/open-console.mjs"
scripts.smoke:demo: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @testpilot/test-management exec playwright install chromium && node scripts/demo-smoke.mjs
scripts.start: pnpm build && concurrently -k -n demo,server -c blue,magenta "pnpm --filter @testpilot/demo-webapp start" "pnpm --filter @testpilot/test-management dev"
